name: Femern Bælt fixed link (Rødbyhavn – Puttgarden)
source_doc: Femern A/S, 'Femern Bælt-tunnelen åbnes i to etaper', 17. maj 2026 · budget: Anlægsstatus 1H 2026 p. 50 — fetched 2026-09-23
notes: Opens in two stages: the road connection first, rail later when the German land facilities are ready. Verified 2026-09-23 against the cited Femern A/S article (17 May 2026): it gives no opening year for the road, and states that Germany said in July 2025 the German rail land facilities cannot open in 2029 as planned; a new timetable follows the first tunnel-element sinkings. Budget 55,100 mio. kr. is in 2015 prices (Anlægsstatus 1H 2026 p. 50), not the report's 2026 prices.

name: Danske landanlæg til Femern (Ringsted – Rødby)
notes: Budget 9.5 mia. kr. in 2015 prices. Phase 1 Ringsted–Nykøbing F. track done 2021, power/signalling 2027; phase 2 Nykøbing F.–Rødby 2028/at the latest 2029.

name: Storstrømsbroen (new road and rail bridge)
notes: schematic corridor — not an official alignment. Straight Masnedø – Orehoved crossing: OpenStreetMap has no way for the new bridge (only the old rail bridges tagged "Sydbanen"), so the status stays construction. Report gives "2026 (vej), 2027 (bane)"; original 2022 (road) / 2018 (rail).

name: Nyt Hospital Nordsjælland (Favrholm, Hillerød)
source_doc: Region Hovedstaden, regionsrådsmøde 15.09.2026, bilag 1 kvartalsrapportering 2. kvartal 2026 (opening) · kvartalsrapport 3. kvartal 2025 (styrende budget) — fetched 2026-09-23
notes: 81 % complete at 30 June 2026; the report prints 'ultimo sep. 2027' for the first patient but also says NCC has warned of a further delay not yet reflected in the schedule. Budget is the last published styrende budget, 7,992 mio. kr. (PL25E2, = 5,618 mio. kr. in PL09); a merbehov of 3,148 mio. kr. was approved 16 June 2026 and the resulting total is not published. The point marks Favrholm station beside the new hospital — the site itself is not in OpenStreetMap.

name: Nyt OUH (Odense Universitetshospital)
source_doc: Region Syddanmark, Årsrapport og ledelsesberetning 2025, s. 9 — fetched 2026-09-23
notes: Handed over successively from July 2026 to February 2027, driftsstart ultimo 2027. The frame is 'lidt mere end 8,2 mia. kr.' after the ministry added 454 mio. kr. in March 2023; the price level is not published. A further 1,528 mio. kr. frame expansion has been requested and its approval is not published, so it is not added here.

name: Nyt Aalborg Universitetshospital (Hospitalsbyen, Gistrup)
notes: Officially inaugurated 12 May 2026, first patients early 2026; relocations continue through 2026 and Aalborg UH Syd stays in use for years. Budget ca. 7,000 mio. kr. anlægsramme with no price level stated; the kvalitetsfond grant was 4,100 mio. kr. (PL09).

name: Nyt Hospital Bispebjerg (Akuthuset)
source_doc: Region Hovedstaden, ordinært regionsrådsmøde 15.09.2026, pkt. 4 Nyt Hospital Bispebjerg — fetched 2026-09-23
notes: No opening year recorded: the region states a 2030–2032 window for the whole project, with the Akuthus handed over in two stages about two years apart. Budget is the approved styrende budget of 3,533 mio. kr. (09PL); a further ~1,750 mio. kr. (2026 prices) is a preliminary estimate and the consolidated budget is expected in 2027. Rebuilt in stages after the total contract was terminated in March 2024.

name: Ny Psykiatri Bispebjerg
notes: Inaugurated 20 March 2026 and in use from 15 April 2026. Not a kvalitetsfond project and no budget is published in the source read. The point marks Bispebjerg Hospital, the site it is built on.

name: Aalborg Plusbus (BRT, bybuslinje 2)
source_doc: Movia, 'BRT-katalog: Seks BRT-projekter på tværs af Danmark', januar 2021 — fetched 2026-09-23
notes: schematic corridor — not an official alignment. Væddeløbsbanen – midtbyen – universitetsområdet – Nyt Aalborg Universitetshospital, 12 km and 22 stations, running as bybuslinje 2. Opening year left empty on purpose: Aalborg Kommune's and NT's Plusbus pages now return 404 after their site moves, and the September 2023 opening date appears only in press. Budget 510 mio. kr. anlægsudgifter (Movia catalogue, 2020 prices).

name: BRT linje 400S, Ring 4 (Ishøj – Lyngby)
source_doc: Vejdirektoratet, 'BRT på linje 400S i Ring 4-korridoren' — fetched 2026-09-23
notes: schematic corridor — not an official alignment. Ishøj St. – Ring 4 – Lyngby St., 33 km. The environmental assessment finished in autumn 2025 and the hearing closed 5 December 2025, but scope, financing and organisation between the state, municipalities, Region Hovedstaden and Movia are unresolved, so there is no opening year. The 950 mio. kr. is the state funding frame (2021 prices) including 50 % state co-financing, not an adopted project budget.

name: BRT linje 200S (Avedøre Holme – Gladsaxe)
notes: schematic corridor — not an official alignment. Avedøre Holme – Hvidovre Hospital – Rødovre Centrum – Husum Torv – Gladsaxe Trafikplads, 18,9 km. A preparatory analysis ran 2022–2025 and nothing has been decided; no budget or opening year is published (Movia's 2021 catalogue estimate of 1,05 mia. kr. is an estimate, not an adopted budget).

name: BRT på Ringvejen, Aarhus (Oddervej – Risskov)
source_doc: Aarhus Kommune, 'Aftale om grøn mobilitetsplan', 7. august 2024 — fetched 2026-09-23
notes: schematic corridor — not an official alignment. Ringvejen from Oddervej in the south to Risskov in the north, ca. 10 km. The 2024 mobility agreement keeps the corridor in planning and sets aside 294,8 mio. kr. of savings for 2024–2034, but the final investment decision is taken in 2028 and depends on the passenger basis, so neither a budget nor an opening year is recorded.

name: BRT/letbane Frederikssundsvej (Nørrebro St. – Gladsaxe)
source_doc: Københavns Kommune, Økonomiudvalget 22.01.2025, punkt 7 'Undersøgelse af BRT/letbane på Frederikssundsvej' — fetched 2026-09-23
notes: schematic corridor — not an official alignment. Nørrebro St. – Frederikssundsvej – Tingbjerg – Gladsaxe Trafikplads. Not decided and not even being studied: Økonomiudvalget rejected the proposal to study BRT alone on 22 January 2025 by 1 vote to 11, and the state's contribution to a study is undecided. Only study money is set aside (7,5 mio. kr. from København, 1 mio. kr. from Gladsaxe), so there is no budget or opening year.

name: Universitetsbyen, Aarhus (former Kommunehospital)
source_doc: Aarhus Universitet, 'Udviklings- og byggeprojekter i Aarhus' — fetched 2026-09-23
notes: The former Kommunehospital site turned into campus; the opening was officially marked over two days in May 2026. No budget is published by AU.

name: Universitetsbyen Syd — Faculty of Arts (Aarhus)
source_doc: Aarhus Universitet, 'Udviklings- og byggeprojekter i Aarhus' — fetched 2026-09-23
notes: In design, with no construction start published. No opening year recorded because two official AU pages disagree: au.dk says phased move-in 2029–2031, medarbejdere.au.dk says 2028–2030. Same site as Universitetsbyen, so the point is shared.

name: DTU Bygning 330 — new DTU Space research building
source_doc: DTU, 'DTU Space nye bygning' / 'Ny forskningsbygning 330 til DTU Space' — fetched 2026-09-23

name: RUC Pergola (Roskilde Universitet)
notes: Transformation and renovation of five buildings plus two link buildings and three bridges, 8,705 m². First stage handed over 16 December 2025, in use 2026. The only ongoing Bygningsstyrelsen project with a published budget.

name: Fremtidens Folketing (Rigsarkivet, Slotsholmen)
notes: 10,000–12,000 m² in the former Rigsarkiv buildings on Slotsholmen; Cobe won the competition in March 2024, but the project was put on hold ('sat i bero') on 30 January 2025. Neither a budget nor a completion year is published.

name: Regionshospitalet Gødstrup (DNV)
source_doc: Region Midtjylland, Regionshospitalet Gødstrup, 'Tidslinje for tilblivelsen af hospitalet 2007-2022' — fetched 2026-09-23
notes: Landmark kvalitetsfond hospital, kept although it is finished. Patients moved in February–March 2022 and the hospital was inaugurated 22 April 2022. The project is closed and accounted for — Region Midtjylland's 2023 note says the accounts closed in 2023, its 2025 note says 2024. Budget 3,150 mio. kr. from the kvalitetsfond; price level not stated on the source page. The psychiatry building (381,1 mio. kr.) was financed by the region outside the grant.

name: Aarhus Universitetshospital, Skejby (DNU)
source_doc: Godt Sygehusbyggeri, 'Solceller fuldender nybyggeri på AUH' — fetched 2026-09-23
notes: Landmark kvalitetsfond hospital, kept although it is finished. Denmark's largest hospital build: inaugurated February 2017, relocations completed on time in 2019, the last sub-project (Forum) finished 2023 and the kvalitetsfond accounts closed in 2024. Budget 6,350 mio. kr. as published ('Budgettet på 6,35 mia. kr. er overholdt'); price level not stated.
